stories.title: Task Query, Sort & Token Gate Probe
stories.body: As a QA engineer validating the Smart Task Manager list engine and auth boundary before release, I want API-level tests for JWT rejection paths, status transitions, Today/Upcoming date filters, priority and due-date sorting (including null due dates), combined AND filters, partial PATCH semantics, and honest stateless logout behavior. This story is intentionally distinct from the Edge Probe and lifecycle samples — it exercises list_tasks sorting/filtering in task_router.py and get_current_user in auth.py without re-testing registration validators, HTML sanitization, or two-user isolation.
acceptance_criteria: GET /tasks/ without an Authorization header must return HTTP 401 with a WWW-Authenticate Bearer header (OAuth2PasswordBearer dependency).

GET /tasks/ with Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.invalid must return HTTP 401 with detail indicating credentials could not be validated (malformed or invalid JWT rejected before DB access).

After registering a fresh user and obtaining a bearer token, POST /tasks/ with {"title":"Sort probe A","priority":"High","status":"Active","due_date":"<tomorrow UTC ISO8601>"} must return HTTP 201; PATCH /tasks/{task_id} with {"status":"Completed"} must return HTTP 200; a subsequent GET /tasks/{task_id} must return HTTP 200 with status "Completed".

Given at least one Active task and one Completed task owned by the same user, GET /tasks/?status=Active must return HTTP 200 and every object in items must have status "Active"; GET /tasks/?status=Completed must return HTTP 200 and every object in items must have status "Completed".

Given one task with due_date on today's UTC calendar day and one task with due_date three days in the future, GET /tasks/?date_filter=Today must return HTTP 200 including only the today-due task; GET /tasks/?date_filter=Upcoming must return HTTP 200 including only the future-due task (date_filter normalisation in list_tasks).

Given three tasks with priorities High, Medium, and Low (same user), GET /tasks/?sort_by=priority&sort_order=asc must return HTTP 200 with items ordered High then Medium then Low (CASE rank in task_router.py).

Given one task with a due_date and one task with due_date omitted (null), GET /tasks/?sort_by=due_date&sort_order=asc must return HTTP 200 with the dated task before the null-due task (nullslast on due_date sort).
Given tasks with mixed status and priority, GET /tasks/?status=Active&priority=High must return HTTP 200 and every item must satisfy both status Active and priority High (logical AND across filters).

PATCH /tasks/{task_id} with only {"priority":"Low"} on a task whose title is known must return HTTP 200; GET /tasks/{task_id} must return HTTP 200 with priority "Low" and the title unchanged (partial update via TaskUpdate exclude_none).

POST /logout must return HTTP 200 with a message to discard the token; a subsequent GET /tasks/ using the same bearer token issued before logout must still return HTTP 200 (stateless JWT — logout is advisory only, documented honest behavior).
